script: Most of the matter in the universe is invisible. Scientists call it dark matter, and nobody knows what it is. It makes up about 85 percent of all matter. We know it is there because galaxies spin too fast to hold together without it. Everything we can see, including all stars and planets, is about 5 percent of the universe.
